newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq to delist American Telecasting shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq to delist American Telecasting shrs.

text.p: American Telecasting Inc said on Thursday that the Nasdaq Stock Market intends to delist the company's stock and that it denied a waiver for listing requirements.
As previously disclosed by American Telecasting, the company's net tangible worth on December 31, 1997, was negative $12,050,000 and did not satisfy the Nasdaq National Market listing criteria.
American Telecasting's securities are scheduled to be delisted on June 18, 1997, but Nasdaq procedures permit the company to appeal this determination to a review committee of Nasdaq.

In addition, the delisting process could result in a decline in the trading market for the class A common stock, which could potentially depress the Company's stock and bond prices, among other consequences, the wireless cable operator said in a statement.
